text: Tucker HiRise will be constructing a 30-storey mixed used development, containing 243 dwelling units, office uses, ground floor retail and a two-level underground parking garage at 203 College Street. The site is located in the south-east quadrant of College Street and Beverley Street. Permanent vehicular access to the site will be from Beverley Street and the public laneway to the east. Major construction activities and associated timeline for the development are described below: 1. Drilling, shoring and excavation work: June 2018 to July 2018 (progressing); 2. Below grade construction: August 2018 to April 2019; and 3. Above grade construction: May 2019 to September 2020. Shoring and excavation activities at the site are currently being undertaken.
